text_block_list.name: Overseas Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! Do you know how to get
to this
hotel?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello! And sure. If you head toward
that
traffic light... Hm, never mind, I'll
just show you
the way! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I got them there safe and
sound, but I
had no idea it'd be so far
away...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And it's going to take just as long to get
back...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl ends up exhausted
after
guiding a lost tourist to their
destination.
